title: Handover domain
description: domain.json in a frozen handover (handovers/<id>/), present only when a touched element owns an aggregate a pinned domain pack defines. Written by Core.handoverPlan at freeze, listed and hashed in handover.yaml (named there as `domain:`), outside the handover id. The pack copies sit under domain/<key>.yaml. designc owns this contract; consumers conform to it. docs/handover-domain.example.json is the shared fixture.

packs.description: The pack copies in this handover, ordered by key.

owners.description: Which element owns which aggregates, ordered by element id.
